content.tex: A sequence has 3 terms. The multiplication of the inside pair is the middle number squared.
\(\frac{Example}{The}\) sequence is \(1 2 3\)
Product of inside pair \(2\times 2 = 2^{2} = 4\) Product of outside pair \(1\times 3\quad = 3\)
Product difference \(4-3\quad = 1\)

\(\frac{Example}{The}\) sequence is \(1\quad 5\)
Product of inside pair \(2\times 4 = 8\) Product of outside pair \(1\times 5 = 5\)
Product difference \(8-5 = 3\)
